proposals.entity_key: Qui as object of verb with intervening subject
value: Qui is invariable; it does not agree in gender or number with its antecedent.
The intervening subject governs its own verb agreement (qui il est, qui elle renverra).

evidence.notes: Qui stays invariable while the subject between qui and the verb controls agreement. AI-generated, unverified.

proposals.entity_key: Quoi after prepositions for indefinite things
value: Quoi is invariable and takes no gender or number agreement.
Quoi refers to indefinite things only, so no antecedent agreement applies.

evidence.notes: Invariable quoi follows prepositions (à quoi, de quoi) with no gender/number marking. AI-generated, unverified.

value: With être the past participle agrees in gender and number with the subject; with avoir it agrees only with a preceding direct object.
The endings -é, -i, -u mark the verb group only; gender and number agreement endings are added separately.

proposals.entity_key: Savoir in present conditional equivalent to pouvoir
value: The conditional form of savoir agrees with the subject in person and number (je ne saurais, vous ne sauriez).
The equivalence with pouvoir does not change subject agreement.

evidence.notes: Formal je ne saurais functions like je ne pourrais while keeping first-person singular agreement. AI-generated, unverified.
